last_review.summary: The change meets the task’s acceptance criteria and architecture constraints. Runtime configuration is typed and validated before NestJS startup, process.env access is confined to src/config/runtime-config.ts, defaults and required values are correct, the example uses fictional mock-only values, and the diff stays within allowed paths. Deterministic build and full-tree layering checks passed.

notes: No tests are executed by this loop; build and full-tree layering check are the deterministic gates.
V1 is entirely in-memory. A restart loses conversations, tasks, event buffers, pending approvals and auth contexts.
NoktosClient runs against an explicitly labelled mock; noktos-auth exposes no public controllers yet.
The Supabase access token never reaches a prompt, event, task payload, log or UI.
contracts/ is frozen at 1.0.0 and is a protected path; changing it is a human operation.
